title: Coloring the Night
caption: The Milky Way and the Rho Ophiuchi cloud complex, near Cerro Pachón, Chile
celestial: Landscape photograph; the source does not name the site
credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/ P. Horálek (Institute of Physics in Opava)

recognition.text: NOIRLab Image of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: The Milky Way's glowing disc stretches across this sky near Cerro Pachón in Chile, partly hidden by dark interstellar dust clouds known as the Great Rift. Some fragments of these dark nebulae seem to reach toward a small cluster of color, the Rho Ophiuchi cloud complex.

That complex mixes reflection nebulae, which scatter blue and yellow light from nearby stars, with emission nebulae, which shine with the reddish light of hot hydrogen gas. Tucked inside it are the star Rho Ophiuchi and Antares, the heart of Scorpius. Above the group lies a much larger deep red emission nebula, Sh2-27, surrounding the star Zeta Ophiuchi.

The soft light to the right of center is the gegenschein, sunlight bounced back by dust particles in the outer Solar System. That dust, which also produces the zodiacal light, comes from sources that include comet tails and collisions between asteroids.

understand.summary: This is a landscape photograph taken with a camera in visible light near Cerro Pachón. The camera settings and processing are not published.
understand.eye: A long camera exposure gathers much more light than the eye, so the colors of the nebulae and the faint gegenschein appear far more clearly than they would to the naked eye.

explore: Cerro Pachón is home to several NSF NOIRLab facilities, among them the SOAR Telescope, Vera C. Rubin Observatory and half of the International Gemini Observatory. This 170-megapixel photograph was taken during the NOIRLab 2022 Photo Expedition by P. Horálek of the Institute of Physics in Opava, and can be explored with a zoom feature.
alt: The Milky Way crosses the sky, cut by dark dust lanes, beside a small patch of blue, yellow and red nebulae and a large deep red glow.
